text: In PC12 cells, transient ERK activation in response to EGF drives sustained differentiation, whereas sustained ERK activation in response to NGF drives only transient proliferation.
explanation: This is false -- the outcomes are reversed. In PC12 cells, EGF produces transient ERK activation and drives proliferation, while NGF produces sustained ERK activation (via a Rap1 -> B-Raf pathway) and drives differentiation. This classic result (Bhalla & Iyengar, 1999) demonstrates that the duration of a signal, not just its identity or the concentration of ligand, can determine cell fate.
